patch_description:
Replace the XX parametrized gates with CZ fixed gates and split the RZ parameter into pre- and post-entanglement phases. This combines the parameter efficiency of the CZ-based design (14 params, score 0.72) with independent phase control before and after entanglement.

Rationale:
- Current design uses 20 params with XX gates, achieving score 0.68
- Prior CZ design used 14 params, achieving score 0.72 (same accuracy, better efficiency)
- Splitting RZ into "rz_pre" (before CZ chain) and "rz_post" (after CZ chain) provides independent phase control while maintaining minimal parameter count (3 total: ry_shared, rz_pre, rz_post)
- CZ gates are fixed and have no parameters, maximizing parameter economy
- The RY→RZ→CZ→RZ motif has proven effectiveness
